title: Task progress expressed as a percentage
description: Regression guard for the percentDone scale (decision 22, docs/ROADMAP.md §3). The prompt says "75% done" in plain English; the verify check reads the RAW REST field, which Vikunja stores as the 0-1 fraction 0.75. It therefore fails if the conversion in src/utils/percent-done.ts is ever removed or doubled: passing 75 straight through would store 75, and converting twice would store 0.0075. It also probes whether an agent reaches for the plain-English percentage at all now that the tool surface takes 0-100 integers — the old 0-1 fraction contract was a memorized gotcha, and a model that has not memorized it used to write `percentDone: 75` and silently get 7500%. optimalCallCount derivation from the CURRENT tool schemas: vikunja_projects create (1) + vikunja_tasks create with title and percentDone set in the SAME call (1) = 2. setup-kanban (PR #175) cannot collapse this to 1: its per-task shape (src/tools/projects/index.ts) accepts title/column/description/priority/dueDate/startDate/endDate/labels/assignees but NOT percentDone, so it cannot reach this end state in one call — no credit given, per docs/BATTLE-TESTING.md's re-baselining policy. Re-derive this number if percentDone is ever added to a project-provisioning composite.
promptTemplate: Create a project called "{{prefix}}Release Prep" with a task called "{{prefix}}draft release notes", and record that the task is 75% done.
